title: Unit 3 Consolidation
goal: Review the geography, peoples, community government, Zapatista history and debates of southern Mexico, and the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: relative clauses, a pesar de, se, para que and aunque

items: I can review what I learned about the landscape and peoples of the south.
I can use relative clauses, *a pesar de*, *se*, *para que* and *aunque* to talk about the south.
I can put the main events of the Zapatista story in order.
I can give both sides of the debate about the Maya Train.
I can describe a cenote or a jungle with a relative clause.
I can say that a tradition continues in spite of pressure, with *a pesar de*.
I can explain what tequio and the assembly are, with *se*.
I can say what the Zapatistas did so that something would happen, with *para que*.
